headline: NCBA Group Lowers Kenya 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to 4.8%
summary: NCBA Group downgraded its economic growth forecast for Kenya in 2026 to 4.8% from 5.1%, citing external shocks.
why: Commercial bank macroeconomic forecasts guide business planning and reflect commercial risk assessments in regional African markets.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Downward revisions in GDP growth expectations signal softer economic activity.
